name: deepseek-chat-electron
description: Electron platform project for DeepSeek Chat.

scripts.pack: npm run build && capacitor-electron vendor && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && capacitor-electron vendor && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && capacitor-electron vendor && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && capacitor-electron vendor && electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:linux:deb: npm run build && capacitor-electron vendor && LINUX_TARGETS=deb electron-builder --linux deb --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:linux:rpm: npm run build && capacitor-electron vendor && LINUX_TARGETS=rpm electron-builder --linux rpm --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.pack:linux:pacman: npm run build && capacitor-electron vendor && LINUX_TARGETS=pacman electron-builder --linux pacman --config electron-builder.config.js
